question: Harshavardhana (r. 606-647 CE) was a ruler of ________ dynasty.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pushyabhuti.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****​Harshavardhana (606 A.D to 647 A.D.​)**

__
 
• **Harshavardhana** turned into born in 590 adverts to King Prabhakaravardhana of Sthaneshvara (Thanesar, Haryana).
 
• He belonged to the Pushyabhuti additionally called the **Vardhana dynasty.**
 
• **The Pushyabhuti dynasty also** known as the Vardhana dynasty dominated northern India at some point in the sixth and 7th centuries.
 
• Harshavardhana built a huge empire that extended from north & northwestern India to the Narmada in the South.
 
• His capital was **Kannauj.**
 
• King Harshavardhana's deeds were praised by the Chinese Buddhist traveler **Xuanzang** in his writings.
 
• **Banabhatta** was his court poet and he composed the **Harshacharita** which gives an account of Harsha’s life and deeds.
 
• Harsha generously supported **Nalanda University**.
 
• Harsha died in 647 AD after ruling for **41 years.**
